changed_factors: K3P's cosine LR, input-noise anneal and output-noise warmup are driven by an internal progress value p (critic paired-order accuracy gate, at most 0.001 per update, monotone) instead of completed_steps/total_steps
Critic spike guard active from the first update (d_guard_min_steps=0) to remove the fixed-count release
mechanism_rationale: Horizon-free annealing: progress advances only while the critic cannot order real above generated samples better than 75%, so schedules follow training state rather than the step label or declared horizon.
